content: Jakva ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ khwaɗga sǝb
A gwidǝn Yasu ǝn kwara tǝra lav dǝ jakva, ni,
“Tlǝksa gharazighǝla ngwaɗa shike, a ɗikarnan ad khwaɗga sǝba kǝ zǝr sar.
Ka ɓǝla tǝrǝf kǝ zar man tlǝr sar, kǝ dǝgal da kwara tǝra kǝ udakhe tsa ɓalgin. Ka kalwal itar kǝ sausǝg.

“Ka gwidǝn ɓǝlatǝrǝf kǝ tlǝrna zar man tlǝr sar kwarne, ‘Kwarama tǝrkhai kwara kǝ liye tsa ɓalgud kwarne, Niya audzala kǝn takhga dǝg zu, a kharga ka kawakh, zǝ kawakh gude tsa ngalgud wulǝklǝk. Itsauɗa audzandalud. Ausǝgam da vak sǝb.’ ”
“Li tsa ɓalgud da vak khwaɗgen, na ɗangwa tsitar dǝ ɓalen bi. Yana dakaval da gukh, yan tsuguna dakaval da man kasukw sar.
Yakhaya tsuguna, ka vaige tar liye tsa ɓǝla tǝrǝfuden, ka mbatǝre tar dǝ dlaɗ char, ka khadztǝr khai itar.
Ka kǝɗga rǝvakhuɗ ad shik char. Ka ɓǝlanǝf ad tlujiyakh sar, dǝgal da khǝdz liye tsa khǝdzga zar man tlǝr sar. Ka ndǝghǝrs itar kǝs tar.
“Tǝkhal kǝ yana, ka niya kǝ zar man tlǝr sar, ‘Audzandalud ɗikana dǝg zuwa khwaɗga sǝb. Ai liye tsa ɓalguda, a dlai ga ba itar tsugun kǝ saks bi.
Wirva yan, gatamars kǝ ghay baramakh, ɓalamga ɓal itsǝra kǝ ude a gamga kur zin, kǝ saks da vak kwaɗgen.’
Zar man tlǝren tsuguna, ka dǝgala tsitar kǝ baram kǝ baram. Ka dzakhadǝghǝr itar ad daghan udakhe a gamge tar zitar, zǝ liye njivva, zǝ liye kwal njiv. A righǝf vak kwaɗgen dǝ ghulabakh char.
“Ka sa shik da vaz liye tsa ɓalgin, ka nǝgh nǝgha tsin ad udanen, ai kwal talǝm gabag khwaɗga sǝben.
Ka niya kǝ udanen, ‘Tsaghw, a sa ndar kha da vana kwal talǝm gabag khwaɗga sǝbi?’ Ka piyarwala dǝg kwar.
“Ka nǝv shik kǝ zar man tlǝr sar, ‘Ndzaɗamarna dǝva zǝ sig, tlǝvamars tlǝva dǝgal da mel, vake dǝ gurtl. Vake da tudin dǝ kǝrɗ tliɗ.’
“Zikǝn liye ɗakhtǝrkhai ud, ai khǝɗikǝn liye dzaravan.”
Ndiɗǝn tǝghǝr kǝ pǝlara khadam kǝ Kaisar Shik
Dud ǝn kwarina, ka dala Farisakh kǝ ɗaya kavu lav ngara dlǝgd kǝ Yasu, kǝ viyaviya tsitar, ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ dǝge da kwarin.

Ka ɓǝlanǝf itar furakh tar, dagha zǝ udakhe khayanǝf dǝ man tlǝksa Khiridus, da vak sar. Ka nǝv itar, “Malǝm, tsa tsǝkǝnda kwarne ud jir khǝ, ǝn tsagdu lav Yazhigǝl kha kalkal. Wirva yakitakw ud ǝn vakagh. Na khǝn gǝdz kwarara lava kǝ ud, itsa ndar zika sar bi.
Kwara kǝnda kwar, da khǝn vazana, kalkal nagh pǝlara khadam tsǝkǝnda kǝ Kaisar, zikan kǝ Shik ǝn Roma, kalkal ba khi?”
Ai Yasu tsuguna, tsa tsin kǝlade ǝn rǝvakhud tar. Ka ndiɗatǝrwal, “Kur nguɗiyakh, uɗa lava tsǝkur ǝn na ngaka dlǝgdi?
Mǝdla maka kwaɓen ǝn pǝl da kur khadamen.” Ka ɓardǝghǝr itar ad kwaɓ dinari.
Ka ndiɗatǝrwal, “Vakdiying zǝ ɗakhǝng ǝn tǝfi?”
Ka ngawar khai itar kwarne, “Dǝg Kaisar.” Ka nǝv Yasu tsitar, “Bamara bǝg kǝ Kaisar ad dǝg Kaisar. Bara kur kǝ Yazhigǝl ad dǝg Yazhigǝl.”
Tsǝna tsitar ndǝk yana, ka ndawatǝrǝf char. Ka ɗuwars itar, dakaval itar.
A ndiɗga Sadukiyakh ad lav ǝn tǝghǝr kǝ tsiyin ngitl
Fitsa va yanen, tǝkǝn Sadukiyakh li kwarne na tsiyin ngitl bi, sagh itar da vak Yasu dǝ ndiɗ.
Ka nǝv itar, “Malǝm, a kwarga Mus kwarne, da ǝmtsǝga ude kwal yiga zǝr dǝ nus sar, barari wura wura kǝ zǝr bab sar ad nus saren, ki yakhar khai zara tsin.
Neg sukwtakh uɗif ǝn tǝbǝnd. Ɓu kǝ zǝr chak ad nus, ka amtsǝgan kwal zar, ɗuwardan ad nus sar kǝ saghǝr sar ai ǝn gatars gat.
A dzogher ndǝk yan kǝ dǝg mits, a yiga ba dǝ zǝr din bi. Ndǝk yan zǝva kǝ dǝg khǝkǝrɗ, tangw da tǝ dǝg uɗif, a yiga ba itar zara din bi.
Kǝ dǝg mbasa, ka ǝmtsǝga nusen.
Fitsa tsiyin ngitla, da nǝga kǝ nus warin ǝn tǝb kǝ udakhana uɗifi? Fatsi daghan tara a zǝɓaruwi?”
Ka ngawa tǝrkhai Yasu, “A zaɗga kur char. Wirvǝn tsa ba kur vindzan na kǝ lav Yazhigǝl bi. Tsuguna, ǝn tsa ba kur ndzǝɗa Yazhigǝl bi.
Fitsa tsiyin ngitla, na dǝɗungw da zǝɓ nus bi. Tsuguna na bud da bǝdu dugh kǝ sǝba bi. Da ngwaɗa zarɓǝlakh Yazhigǝl ǝn gharazhigǝl itar.
Ən tǝghǝr kǝ fitse da tsida tlamtsakh ǝn ngitla, a tugwa bakh kur dǝge a kwara kur khai Yazhigǝla? A vindzavan kwarne,
‘Ka Yazhigǝl Ibram. Ka Yazhigǝl Ishaku. Ka Yazhigǝl Yakub?’ A mǝdlanan kwarne Yazhigǝl tlamtsakh ba ka bi, Yazhigǝl liye dǝ safa kǝ.”
Tsǝna kǝ dzakhava udakh ndǝk yan, ka ndawatǝrǝf, wirva tsagdutsaga saren.
Ndzikhe a malgan ad ndzikha ndzikhakh daghan
Tsǝna kǝ Farisakh kwarne a bǝlaterghǝr Yasu ak Sadukiyakh, ka dzafkhai itar ǝn vak kitakul.
Fang a tǝb kǝ li wagayal ǝn tsa ndzikha ndzikh Mus, ka kurakura tsin dǝ ndiɗ.
“Malǝm, ira kǝ ndzikh ǝn ndzikha ndzikh Yazhigǝle a maltǝr khai kǝ yakhaya daghani?”
Ka ngawar khai Yasu kwarne, “ ‘Waya dǝ Dadzikan Yazhigǝl gha, dǝ rǝvakhuɗagha daghan, dǝ safagha daghan, zǝ ɗayaghǝragha daghan.’
Ina dǝg chak, in tsugun kǝ maltǝr khai kǝ yakhaya daghan.
Dǝg mits kǝ ndzikhe a malgan ad yakhaya kǝ ndzikha ndzikhakhen tsuguna, ngwaɗa dǝg chak ghǝrsar. ‘Waya dǝ udakh daghan ndikve ǝn wayakha ghǝragh.’
Daghan dǝge a vindzavan ǝn ndzikha ndzikh Mus, zai in kaɗkaɗakh tlayangakh Yazhigǝl, a ghitso ǝn tǝ ndzikha ndzikhakhana mits itar.”
Zǝr warek Kristu ra?
Dzafkhai kǝ Farisakh ǝn tǝ dǝva kitakw, ka ndiɗatǝrwal Yasu,
“Uɗa ɗayaghǝrur ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ Kristuwi? Zǝr warek kini? “Zǝr Dod,” nǝv itar.
Ka ndiɗatǝrwal Yasu, “Uɗa lava kǝ Dod tsugun ǝn tǝ dǝva dǝ Sǝɗikw Yazhigǝl ǝn ɗakhin dǝ Dadzikani? Wirva nǝv Dod,

content.text: Ndzǝga ndzǝg ǝn tǝ dǝva kafar.

content: “Da ka ǝn ɗakha dǝ ‘Dadzikan,’ Dod ad Kristu, ai da nala ndar, Kristu kǝ zǝr sari?”
Na ude ngawar khai bi. Ve tsǝn tǝ yanen kǝ khǝna, na dla ude sigwif kǝ ndiɗarwal ndiɗa bi.
